intent: A manual story carousel pairing original geometric studies with editorial copy and large figures, with clear controls and no autoplay.

layout.direction: Pair a geometric study with a compact editorial story. Stack art above copy in a narrow container and place the previous/next controls below both. Keep orbit, grid and steps artwork original and neutral. Use 36px Instrument Serif story headings, 14px body copy and 12px metadata, with a large display figure supplied as text.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

motion.entrance: Each keyed story arrives with opacity and an 8px rise over 320ms. Controls remain outside the changing story.
motion.interaction: Use the existing 150ms press response. Navigation is manual, with no autoplay or ambient loops.
motion.reduced: Listen to live preference changes. Stop and settle the current story immediately while preserving the controls and focus; subsequent reduced-motion stories enter without travel.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: slides
props.description: Unique IDs, headings, copy, figures and orbit/grid/steps artwork variants.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial slide. Finite values are floored and clamped to the available range; non-finite values select the first slide.

props.name: onSlideChange
props.description: Zero-based active slide after explicit navigation.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep the public StoryDeckProps and StorySlide types. Every slide supplies an id, kicker, title, description, figure, caption and orbit/grid/steps pattern. IDs are stable and unique.
Selection is local. Floor finite defaultIndex values and clamp them to the current collection; non-finite values choose the first slide. Replacing or shrinking slides retains a valid displayed index.

Previous and next are labelled native buttons with 44px targets. Disable unavailable directions. onSlideChange reports a zero-based index synchronously after explicit navigation; the host owns persistence.

Expose a named carousel and slide position, plus a polite position counter. Empty slides show a written empty state and disable both controls. Preserve long content without horizontal document overflow.
